title: Who is involved: Declaration & Brand Launch

story.text:
# Who is involved

**Active cast.** "There's the mice there's the henry henry there's the... vision fish that are front and center and have been prepared," though "we won't have 42 by then." Prepared vision fish act as unpaid advertising: "they'll like repost the declaration and audrey might write a thing about it." Robbie sends the teaser manifesto out and drafts a personal invite list. Mitch acts on his "at least 30 to 40 people in the... city of majors and the agent privacy... telegram chats" and "that lady who wrote the prophecy book." Max gives a lead to Berlin contacts "the swarm and the bonfires." Alina is "an immediate go-to" via her "autistic network" and "octopus network" / "squid connection."

**Being invited or network activated.** Robbie's aspirational invitees, who "might take a few months to say yes": "larry lessig," "the lawyer from creative commons and the constitutional lawyer," "the swarm foundation or the ethereum foundation," "the stand-up comedian," "a theater arts group." A mission to "invite three women" (revised to two) to the mice. Plus underground media, an NDA-gated OpenServe first-look deal, and "that turkish... group that our man was talking about," who are "really hardcore."
See [[Declaration & Brand Launch]]  ·  hub: [[Who is Involved?]]
